data.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
data.detailed_description:
Welcome back BB fans! It’s time to bring back BATTLE BEARS GOLD!

Relive your childhood as this beloved third-person shooter comes to your PC. Grab your A Salt Rifle, Bearzooka and those Turkish SW Boots and fight it out with friends across beloved Battle Bears locations.

Pick between 11 distinct classes and compete for dominance across competitive 4v4 multiplayer modes. Whether you're a Team Battle diehard or prefer the underrated Plant the Bomb, there is plenty of battling to be done.

Iconic Maps will return so prepare to jump back into classics such as No Bears Land, Gold Digger and Space Oddity. You can even make some time for that yearly match on Steamyard Blues, most likely just for the soundtrack.

Speaking of music, this game has bangers so get ready to enjoy that awesome OST once again.

Key Features:

Play as 11 Hero Classes with distinct capabilities:

-SOLDIER: Oliver

-HEAVY: Riggs

-DEMOLITION: Tillman

-HUGGABLE: Huggable

-SNIPER: Astoria

-CHUB SCOUT: Wil

-ENGINEER: Graham

-ASSAULT: B-1000

-ASSASSIN: Botch

-COMBAT TECH: Saberi

-ARBITER: Sanchez

Try thousands of unique LOADOUT combos:

80+ PRIMARY WEAPONS

60+ SECONDARY WEAPONS

50+ MELEES

10 SPECIAL EQUIPMENT

200+ COSMETIC ITEMS

Dominate in Competitive Modes:

-Team Deathmatch (TDM)

-Free for All (FFA)

-Plant the Bomb (PTB)

Level Up and Climb the Ranks:

-Increase your level to access new items

-Reach Diamond Rank to impress your friends

Additional note: All assets in this game are created by human artists.

If all of this excites you, please WISHLIST the game to help us get the word out.
More news on the way soon and we want to thank you for your incredible patience!

data.short_description: The ORIGINAL Mobile Multiplayer Shooting Game comes to PC! Compete with your friends in vibrant sci-fi maps across multiple game modes. Choose from 11 unique classes, with thousands of loadout combinations to master. We’ll see you on the battlefield in 2026!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4th Gen / AMD FX-8300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen R5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
